title: The Dues Standing Adjustment in a Circle Year's Credit
content:
## Adjusting a Circle year's credit for how the dues stand

The credit granted for a Northbeam Circle Membership year is adjusted for how the year's dues stand, read
from the dues payments and the dues charges booked in the twelve months ending on the handling day.

1. Where the dues payments booked in the twelve months ending on the handling day stand at or above the
   dues charged in that window, the paid in full addition of this schedule, 25.00, is added.
2. Where those payments stand below the dues charged in that window by the arrears threshold of this
   schedule, 50.00, or more, the arrears offset of this schedule, 30.00, is taken off.
3. Where neither of those holds, no adjustment is made for how the dues stand, and 0.00 goes into the
   year's credit on this account.

## Both sides of the two boundaries

| Dues charged in the window | Dues payments in the window | How the dues stand | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 160.00 | 160.00 | Level | 25.00 added |
| 160.00 | 190.00 | Payments above charges | 25.00 added |
| 160.00 | 110.00 | Short by exactly 50.00 | 30.00 taken off |
| 160.00 | 109.00 | Short by 51.00 | 30.00 taken off |
| 160.00 | 120.00 | Short by 40.00 | None |

A shortfall of exactly the arrears threshold reaches the second reading, because that reading is met at the
threshold or more. A shortfall smaller than the threshold reaches neither reading, so the year's credit is
neither raised nor lowered on this account.

## Which way each reading runs

The paid in full addition is an addition and the arrears offset is taken off, so the two readings pull the
year's credit in opposite directions; the third leaves it untouched on this account.
